translations.translation: For skin tired from daily irritation and dryness, low-molecular collagen and hyaluronic acid absorb layer by layer, comfortably replenishing from within.
Use right after cleansing while skin is still damp to help active ingredients settle in deeper and keep skin moisturized all day.
A fresh, non-sticky finish that helps ease inner tightness—easy to use before makeup.
A bouncy, skin-hugging texture for makeup-ready skin
Dual-moisture design: fresh on the outside, deeply hydrated within
Gently absorbs even into sensitive skin that feels unsettled each seasonal change.
Upon application, a thin moisture film forms over skin to help prevent moisture loss.
The Centella Asiatica Extract in this product is purified from Madagascar-sourced ingredients using low-temperature extraction to minimize loss of active components.
Before use, apply a small amount to the inner back of your hand to check for any unusual reaction, then use on the face.
This advertising copy is based on personal user experience and does not guarantee the same results for all users.
